batch.description: Hajee Mohammad Danesh Science and Technology University (HSTU) admission test, academic session 2018-2019 — ONE complete 100-question MCQ paper (Physics 25 + Chemistry 25 + Biology 25 + English 25) transcribed 2026-10-31 by direct visual reading of the HSTU section (printed book pp.143-149) of Udvash's 'GST গুচ্ছ প্রশ্নব্যাংক', distributed as a TargetPDF Telegram-channel scan. CRITICAL: the source prints NO unit label (A/B/D/E/F) and NO set/shift label anywhere on its 7 pages, so the paper's unit is recorded as 'unassigned' — it must NOT be attributed to any HSTU unit until unit identity is established by question-level cross-verification (a later stage). Each subject is numbered independently 01-25 and split into syllabus-tier blocks (Short/Extra, Biology also Old) that re-use the same numbers; the pack merges tiers by printed number, so questionNumber is the subject-local printed number. There is no answer table: every question carries its key inline, as an '[Ans: x]' tag or as the head of a worked solution 'সমাধান: (x)'. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are content-UNVERIFIED and all keys answer-UNVERIFIED; the printed publisher (Udvash) keys are preserved exactly as printed, including two dual keys (Physics 16 via its solution, Physics 24 via its tag), and are NOT official HSTU keys. PDF p.6 is scan-cropped at the right edge; the clipped [Ans:] letters on that page were read at zoom. This is a third-party publisher compilation, not an official HSTU publication. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]
